heroSummary: Sweetwater UHSD begins the regular 2026-2027 7-12 school year on Wednesday, July 22, 2026 and ends Friday, June 4, 2027. Spring Break runs March 22-April 2, 2027. Sweetwater UHSD follows an earlier-than-many-districts July start schedule, making the first-week planning period important for families.
calendarNotes: Sweetwater UHSD starts the regular 2026-2027 7-12 school year on July 22, 2026 and ends on June 4, 2027. The student calendar lists 180 student days, Fall Break from September 21-October 2, Thanksgiving Break from November 23-27, Winter Break from December 21-January 8, and Spring Break from March 22-April 2. Sweetwater UHSD also publishes a separate 2026-2027 OMCHS student calendar that starts on August 11, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Sweetwater UHSD start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of school for regular 7-12 students is Wednesday, July 22, 2026. The OMCHS student calendar starts on Tuesday, August 11, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Sweetwater UHSD Fall Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break runs Monday, September 21 through Friday, October 2, 2026 on the regular 7-12 student calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Sweetwater UHSD Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 22 through Friday, April 2, 2027 on the regular 7-12 student calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the school year end for Sweetwater UHSD in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The school year ends for regular 7-12 students on Friday, June 4, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: How many student days are in the Sweetwater UHSD 2026-2027 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The official Sweetwater UHSD 2026-2027 regular student calendar lists 180 student days.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Sweetwater UHSD publish an OMCHS calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Sweetwater UHSD publishes a separate 2026-2027 OMCHS Student Calendar. OMCHS families should use that PDF for final date planning.

calendarFaqs.q: How do I add the Sweetwater UHSD calendar to Google Calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Download the Sweetwater UHSD ICS calendar file from this page, open Google Calendar, choose Import, upload the ICS file, and confirm the imported dates. The file is a one-time calendar import, not a live district sync.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Sweetwater UHSD have school tomorrow?
calendarFaqs.a: Same-day closures and emergency schedule changes are not controlled by the annual student calendar. Families should check official Sweetwater UHSD announcements, campus messages, and local emergency updates for tomorrow's school status.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Sweetwater UHSD summer break start?
calendarFaqs.a: Summer break begins after the regular 7-12 school year ends on Friday, June 4, 2027. OMCHS families should confirm end-of-year dates using the separate OMCHS student calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: How many weeks is Sweetwater UHSD winter break?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs Monday, December 21, 2026 through Friday, January 8, 2027, covering three calendar weeks on the regular 7-12 student calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Sweetwater UHSD have a year-round calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The regular Sweetwater UHSD 7-12 student calendar is a traditional calendar. Sweetwater UHSD also publishes a separate OMCHS student calendar, so OMCHS families should use that official PDF for final planning.

calendarFaqs.q: What time does Sweetwater UHSD school start?
calendarFaqs.a: School start times vary by campus. Families should check the student's school website or official campus bell schedule for start times, dismissal times, and same-day schedule changes.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Sweetwater UHSD release the 2027-2028 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Sweetwater UHSD publishes future student calendars when they are approved and posted by the district. Families should check the official Sweetwater UHSD student calendars page for newly released 2027-2028 calendar versions.

customSections.label: Sweetwater UHSD Calendar Overview 2026-2027
customSections.content:
The Sweetwater UHSD 2026-2027 regular student calendar provides districtwide dates for grades 7-12. Families can use it to track the first day of school, Fall Break, Thanksgiving Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, legal holidays, declared holidays, non-instructional days, semester end dates, AP testing windows, and the school year end date.

This page summarizes the regular student calendar and links to the separate OMCHS student calendar for families who follow that alternate schedule.

customSections.label: Sweetwater UHSD OMCHS Calendar 2026-2027
customSections.content: Sweetwater UHSD publishes a separate 2026-2027 OMCHS Student Calendar. The OMCHS calendar lists August 11, 2026 as the first day of school, December 18, 2026 as the end of first semester, January 20, 2027 as the second semester start, and June 4, 2027 as the school year end. OMCHS families should use the OMCHS PDF for final date planning.

customSections.content: Sweetwater UHSD families use the student calendar because the regular 7-12 schedule has an early July start, multiple two-week breaks, and a separate OMCHS calendar. These calendar patterns affect summer activities, South Bay travel, work schedules, and school transitions before families choose exact dates.

groups.label: Calendar pattern to note
items: The regular 7-12 year begins in late July, so summer planning may need to happen earlier than for nearby August-start districts.
Fall Break and Spring Break each span two school weeks, making them the main extended planning windows.
The OMCHS calendar uses a separate schedule, so families should identify the correct calendar before using these dates.

groups.label: Why dates can differ
items: Campus events, athletics, bell schedules, testing windows, and graduation details may be announced separately from the districtwide student calendar.
Emergency closures and same-day changes should always be checked through official district and campus announcements.
Families comparing nearby San Diego County calendars should confirm each district's start date because Sweetwater UHSD begins earlier than many local calendars.

customSections.label: Sweetwater UHSD Local Calendar Insight
customSections.content: Sweetwater UHSD differs from many nearby San Diego-area districts because the regular 7-12 student year begins in late July, while many nearby calendars begin in August. Families comparing South Bay school calendars should check district-specific start dates before arranging childcare, work schedules, or vacations. This earlier start date can affect summer scheduling because families may have fewer weeks between summer activities and the first student day compared with August-start districts.

customSections.label: How We Verify Sweetwater UHSD Calendar Dates
customSections.content:
MySchoolDates reviews the official Sweetwater UHSD student calendars page, the regular 7-12 student calendar PDF, and published alternate-calendar PDFs such as the OMCHS student calendar. Key dates such as first day, school year end, semester end dates, Fall Break, Thanksgiving Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, holidays, non-instructional days, AP testing windows, and alternate-calendar dates are compared against the official PDFs before being converted into the calendar file used on this page.

The official Sweetwater UHSD calendar remains the source of record for revisions, campus-specific events, emergency closures, bell schedules, and same-day announcements.
